name: Minor Medical Miracle
description: If the Field Medic reaches a character at -10 hit points or lower within 3 rounds of death, a DC 30 Treat Injury check (no take 10/20) lets the dead character attempt a DC 15 Fortitude save to stabilize at 0 hit points.
